{
 "title": "Implement and validate task transform",
 "command": "cat > programs/task-26b69cdf.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            top, left = min(y for y,x in cells), min(x for y,x in cells)
            shape = [(y-top, x-left) for y,x in cells]
            bh = max(y for y,x in shape) + 1
            bw = max(x for y,x in shape) + 1
            objects.append((left, top, color, shape, bh, bw))
    objects.sort(key=lambda obj: obj[0])
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    oy = ox = 0
    for i, (_, _, color, shape, bh, bw) in enumerate(objects):
        if i:
            py, px = objects[i-1][4], objects[i-1][5]
            oy += py - 1
            ox += px - 1
        for dy, dx in shape:
            y, x = oy+dy, ox+dx
            if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
                out[y][x] = color
    return out
PY
